topic: Index Weekly Move: US metro colo ladder, Silicon Valley $238 vs Dallas $173, Chicago +14.7% YoY

facts: Wholesale, USD per kW per month: Silicon Valley $238; Chicago $215; Los Angeles (Southern California) $213; New York Tri-State $213; Hillsboro (Portland) $205; Phoenix $195; Atlanta $193; Houston $180; Dallas–Fort Worth $173; Northern Virginia (Ashburn) $173
Chicago: wholesale $215/kW/month, +14.7% YoY (underlying source: CBRE, Global Data Center Trends 2026)
North America (avg): wholesale $196/kW/month, +6.5% YoY (underlying source: CBRE, North America Data Center Trends H2 2025)
Northern Virginia (Ashburn): wholesale $173/kW/month, +1.5% YoY (CBRE, North America Data Center Trends H1 2026, 10MW+ blocks)
Most US metros are 250–500 kW asking rates (CBRE, North America Data Center Trends H1 2026, 27 Aug 2026)

caption:
$173 per kW per month: wholesale colo in Northern Virginia, the cheapest end of the US ladder on the Coloprice Index.

Silicon Valley sits at $238, so a kW costs 1.4x more there than in Dallas–Fort Worth at $173. Chicago is the fastest riser at +14.7% YoY. The North America average is $196, up 32% from Dec 2023 to Dec 2025 and flat since. Note the mixed bases: 10MW+ blocks in Northern Virginia, 250–500 kW asking rates elsewhere.

Data: Coloprice Colocation Index, Oct 2026 (CBRE underlying). Sources on the last slide.
